retrievalProfile.description: A rhythmic multi-subject layout featuring vertical portrait strips separated by bold primary-colored bars and topped with a clean serif header.

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured grid of five vertical portrait panels, each separated by a thick, solid-colored vertical bar. The composition is anchored by a horizontal header bar at the top containing lowercase serif text, creating a vibrant, rhythmic repetition of subjects and colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical repetition of subjects creates a sense of group unity
Primary color bars act as rhythmic dividers and structural anchors
Horizontal header balances the strong verticality of the panels
High-contrast color blocking against varied photographic backgrounds
coreInvariants: Solid color vertical dividers (cyan, yellow, etc.)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects are centered within their respective vertical strips, shown from the waist up at a consistent scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid yellow and cyan vertical bars provide the primary structural framework.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves horizontally across the panels from left to right, guided by the repeating vertical rhythm.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and bold color blocks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (shadows and clothing) and Red (accent block)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant green and teal (backgrounds within panels)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high-value highlights in the photography.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on a solid color header bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact against complex imagery.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the original.
Provides a similar classic editorial feel with clear lowercase forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a layout with five vertical portrait panels separated by thick cyan and yellow bars. Each panel should contain a different person in 80s fashion against vibrant green or blue backgrounds. Add a solid yellow horizontal bar across the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset lowercase serif text in black on the top-right yellow bar, right-aligned, followed by a simple black asterisk.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly five vertical portrait panels?
Are the vertical dividers solid cyan and yellow?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific primary colors used for dividers
mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact brand logos
Ensure the asterisk is a generic geometric shape
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting across all five portraits
Verify that the vertical bars are perfectly parallel
Ensure the text is legible against the yellow header
Confirm the 80s aesthetic through hair and clothing styles
recipe.reuseFormula: 5-Panel Vertical Grid + Primary Color Dividers + Top-Right Serif Header
